mapper.select:
select distinct STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_ID , STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_NAME, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.REGIST_ORG, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.TRD_ACCT_ID, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.REC_ACCT_ID,STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_SOURCE secAcctSource, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.TRADE_PLACE tradePlace, c1.acctName acctName, c1.busiAcctNo1 busiAcctNo1,c2.busiAcctNo2 busiAcctNo2 from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO left join (select distinct ACCT_NO acctNo1,BUSI_ACCT_NO busiAcctNo1,CCY ccy, ACCT_NAME acctName from STL_CAPACCT_INFO)c1 on STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.TRD_ACCT_ID=c1.acctNo1 and STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.TRD_ACCT_CCY=c1.ccy LEFT join(select distinct ACCT_NO acctNo2,BUSI_ACCT_NO busiAcctNo2,CCY ccy from STL_CAPACCT_INFO)c2 on STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.REC_ACCT_ID=c2.acctNo2 and STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.REC_ACCT_CCY=c2.ccy LEFT join PTL_SEC_ACCT on STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_ID = PTL_SEC_ACCT.ACCT_NO
(STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_ID LIKE concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId},'%')) OR STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_NAME LIKE concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId},'%')))
and STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.REGIST_ORG=${registOrg}
AND PTL_SEC_ACCT.PORTFOLIO_ID like concat('%',concat(#{portfolioId},'%'))
AND NVL(STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.sec_acct_type, 'SEC') = 'SEC'/*只查询证券账户*/

select SEC_ACCT_ID code, SEC_ACCT_ID name, SEC_ACCT_NAME shortName, SEC_ACCT_ID hidCode FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO
SEC_ACCT_ID like concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId},'%')) or SEC_ACCT_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{secAcctId},'%'))
AND NVL(STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.sec_acct_type, 'SEC') = 'SEC'/*只查询证券账户*/

select ACCT_NO id, concat(ACCT_Name, CCY) text, CCY col /*多级法人改造，增加STL_CAPACCT_INFO.BUSI_ACCT_NO查询字段 add by caojin 2020/6/12 start */ ,SEQ_NO seqNo /*多级法人改造，增加STL_CAPACCT_INFO.BUSI_ACCT_NO查询字段 add by caojin 2020/6/12 end */ FROM STL_CAPACCT_INFO
ACCT_NO like concat('%',concat(#{busiAcctNo},'%')) or ACCT_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{busiAcctNo},'%'))

select SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName, SEC_ACCT_SOURCE secAcctSource, REGIST_ORG registOrg, TRD_ACCT_ID trdAcctId, REC_ACCT_ID recAcctId, REMARK remark, CREATE_USER createUser, CREATE_DEPT createDept, CREATE_TIME createTime, UPDATE_USER updateUser, UPDATE_TIME updateTime,TRADE_PLACE tradePlace,SEC_ACCT_SOURCE secAcctSource from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO WHERE SEC_ACCT_ID=#{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NVL(sec_acct_type, 'SEC') = 'SEC'/*只查询证券账户*/
select count(*) from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO WHERE SEC_ACCT_ID=#{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NVL(sec_acct_type, 'SEC') = 'SEC'/*只查询证券账户*/
select count(*) from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO WHERE SEC_ACCT_Name=#{secAcctName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NVL(sec_acct_type, 'SEC') = 'SEC'/*只查询证券账户*/
select count(*) count from PTL_SEC_ACCT T1 ,STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO T2 where T1.ACCT_NO=T2.SEC_ACCT_ID and T2.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NVL(T2.sec_acct_type, 'SEC') = 'SEC'/*只查询证券账户*/

SELECT PTL_SEC_ACCT.PORTFOLIO_ID code, PTL_SEC_ACCT.ACCT_NO shortName FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ON PTL_SEC_ACCT.ACCT_NO = STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_ID
AND (PORTFOLIO_ID like concat('%',concat(#{portfolioId},'%')) OR ACCT_NO like concat('%',concat(#{portfolioId},'%')) )
AND NVL(STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.sec_acct_type, 'SEC') = 'SEC'/*只查询证券账户*/
